data.reason_zh: 提出智能体驱动的可微科学软件生态，由评估反馈驱动修订，验证成果作为共享资源供后续研究复用。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Research requirements guide development, with implementations assessed through independent derivative checks, workflow tests and performance evaluation.
scope_support.object_quote: Research-driven revisions make previously unsupported workflows differentiable, correct derivatives of scientific observables and eliminate redundant computation.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Validated software, research programs and tests become shared resources for subsequent studies.
